geometry_evaluation.description: Held-out frames, static manmade surfaces, symmetric nearest-neighbour distances without fitting a transform; diagnostic, not an independent dataset. No geometry or labels from these frames enter the loop detector.

config.evaluation_reference: Official KITTI odometry poses (not SemanticKITTI poses), interpolated at original TUM timestamps; one SE(3) alignment, no scale.
config.selection: Parameters frozen before execution. No GT, labels or predictions are read by backend.py. One paired feasibility experiment, not a cross-sequence benchmark.
